tools.name: ras_posts_list_capabilities
tools.description: List customer-safe eligible post connections. Requires posts:read.

tools.name: ras_posts_list_drafts
tools.description: List customer-safe draft projections. Requires posts:read.

tools.name: ras_posts_get_draft
tools.description: Read one opaque draft projection. Cross-tenant access returns opaque not-found. Requires posts:read.

tools.name: ras_posts_create_draft
tools.description: Create or safely replay a draft only. Requires posts:write and Idempotency-Key. Media must be []. Scheduling and publish are unsupported.
